description: Classifies an IPv4 or IPv6 address: family, canonical form, and whether it is public, private (RFC 1918 or unique local), loopback, link-local, carrier-grade NAT, multicast, documentation, or reserved, including IPv4-mapped IPv6. With no input over HTTP, returns the caller's own public IP and country. Useful for validating network input and filtering internal addresses. Not charged for an invalid address. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address. Omit (HTTP only) to get your own IP.

name: ip_info
title: IP address check: IPv4/IPv6, public or private, reserved ranges; or your own IP
